$comment: Stage list for the task skill. One row per stage. gate: the approval-gate question; null means the stage runs unattended (Stages 3-4). skills: names resolved against sibling skill dirs (../<name>/SKILL.md) or paths relative to this skill's root. dispatch: subagent role names carried in the SKILL.md body, not on-disk skills. playbooks: files under playbooks/. Rendered and validated by scripts/stages.mjs. Editing stages means editing this file, never the SKILL.md body.

stages.name: Clarify
stages.gate: Ask the user to confirm the brief. Until they do, stop. Do not build anything.

stages.name: Plan
stages.gate: Approve this plan and start implementation?

stages.name: Publish
stages.gate: Show the proposed publication scope and ask for approval before any commit or push.
